high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "artbysehgal," which was posted 9 hours prior to the screenshot being taken at 01:44. The post features a vibrant and abstract painting by the artist "meghavimehta." The painting depicts multiple human figures in various poses, with their bodies intertwined and overlapping in a dynamic and chaotic manner. The figures appear to be nude or partially clothed, with different colors and shapes used to represent their forms. The background is a mix of neutral tones, providing contrast to the vivid colors of the figures.
